name: Strike of Silence (Combat)
body:
Your opponents talk to much. Use a shield to render them speechless.

Prerequisites: Power Attack, shield proficiency, base attack bonus +4

Benefit: When making a successful Power Attack with a shield, the target is silenced for 1 round.

Special: The silence effect from multiple attacks does not stack.

Normal: A spellcaster is unable to cast a spell with a verbal component while silenced.
